core.segment: A level-based EnergyDetector behind a SpeechDetector trait instead of a neural detector, because it needs no model file. Cost: it measures energy, not speech, so loud music passes. Silero is a cargo feature and the CLI does not expose it.
core.acoustic: Four deterministic measurements instead of a learned quality model, with scoring kept apart from FilterPolicy, so thresholds change without re-reading audio. Cost: babble noise reads up to 2.7 dB cleaner than it is.
core.shard: Shards are built in a staging directory and renamed into place, so readers never see a partial tar. Cost: staging and output must be on the same volume, and the writer refuses an output directory that already holds a run.
entry.serve: The live path runs the same StreamSegmenter that batch uses, so verdicts cannot drift apart. Cost: a clip is judged only after its closing pause, and live audio is not loudness-leveled.
